name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
summary: Krusk wants Lord Aliden Perenolde, leader of the Syndicate, dead and the Warchief's pendant recovered. His manor stands north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake, and his mistress Elysa is the one to ask about the pendant.

sections.title: The Lord of the Syndicate
sections.body: After Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk says Perenolde has to die, and the world be rid of his foulness. The manor sits a way to the north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake, at Dandred's Fold. When the deed is done, you are to put your questions about Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires, to his mistress Elysa.

sections.title: A Frightened Mistress
sections.body: Elysa is terrified when you come to her. She cries that she never meant your people any harm and that Perenolde kept her against her will, and she begs to be spared.

faq.q: Who sends you to kill Lord Aliden Perenolde?
aliases: who gives lord aliden perenolde quest
where do i get lord aliden perenolde
faq.answer: Krusk, after you have finished Blackmoore's Legacy.

faq.q: Where is Lord Aliden Perenolde located?
faq.answer: In his manor on the shores of Lordamere Lake, a way to the north. He is upstairs in the house at Dandred's Fold.

faq.q: What item are you sent to retrieve after killing Perenolde?
faq.answer: Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires. You are to ask Perenolde's mistress, Elysa, about it.

aliases: what is after lord aliden perenolde
faq.answer: Taretha's Gift, the next part of the chain.
